rulings: Position ru-ev-palm-place: «Район Мухайрис, Эль-Мубарраз» approved unchanged. Accuracy 30/30: renders AR «حي محيرس، المبرز» (governing) and EN «Muhairis district, Al-Mubarraz» exactly — district + city, nothing added (no street, building number, Айн-Мансур, direction or description). Nativeness 28/30: natural Russian address-list shape; the capitalised generic «Район» + undeclined name follows the binding sibling wafrah-winter «Район Эль-Вафра, …» and the termbase district pattern (район Эль-Фейсал, район Эш-Шуруфия); the bare city after the comma matches bisht / qaisariyah-nights / kafu-nights / dates-festival «…, Эль-Хуфуф». -2 only because a district+city line is inherently terse. Termbase 18/20: «Эль-Мубарраз» verbatim from the verified entry (ru.wikipedia, saudipedia; non-solar م → Эль-); «Мухайрис» verbatim from the approved title_ru «Дворец Мухайрис» and the entries «дворец Мухайрис» / «Каср-Мухайрис»; no article on «Мухайрис» since Arabic «محيرس» has no «ال»; nominative with «район» per the termbase rule. -2 because the Мухайрис stem remains status pending (practical-transcription table only, zero Russian attestations) — a standing termbase state, not a defect of this string, and the line has no better-sourced form. Fit 8/10: the page now carries a map pin and «Открыть в Google Картах», so the line plus map is usable; -2 since neither name is self-locating for a foreign visitor (a source-level limit, see blind point 1). Structure 10/10: single plain-text TS string, one line, U+0020 only, no markdown, field name unchanged. Article ruling (not re-litigated): the line's settled rule is that «Аль-Ахса» is the fixed head-name of the whole site (termbase Al-Ahsa: UNESCO official «Оазис Аль-Ахса», brand name), while every other Arabic toponym takes the transcribed article — «Эль-» before lunar letters, assimilated before solar letters (SKILL: Эль-Хуфуф · Эр-Рияд · Эш-Шаркия); termbase «район Эль-Фейсал» explicitly rejects «Аль-» (guarded by C20), and «Эль-Вафра» rejects «Аль-Вафра». «Эль-Мубарраз» is therefore correct and the Эль-/Аль- coexistence is by design.
blind_disposition: Blind reader RESULT serious=0 minor=4 note=6; points touching this string: 1 and 7. Point 7 («Эль-Мубарраз» vs «Аль-Ахса») — rejected: settled line rule — «Аль-Ахса» is the UNESCO/brand head-name exception; all other toponyms use «Эль-» (lunar) per the verified termbase entry «Эль-Мубарраз» and C20; changing either would overrule sourced termbase entries on taste. Points 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 do not touch this string (duration value, «Ключевые моменты», organiser announcements, season labels, «Организаторы», section names, other events' names, text-dump concatenation) — outside this batch's single position; not ruled here, recorded for a later ru polish batch if the owner wishes (points 2–6, 8, 9 are existing published strings; point 10 is an artefact of the text dump).
